name: assetopt
description: Static asset optimization tool — open-source CLI for images, CSS, JS and SVG
author: Nath

scripts.release:dry-run: npm run release:check && npm publish --dry-run --workspace @assetopt/core && npm publish --dry-run --workspace @assetopt/cli
scripts.release: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:run && npm run build && npm run release:check && npm publish --workspace @assetopt/core && npm publish --workspace @assetopt/cli
